conditions.quote_anchor: We cannot have price intersect or cut through.

conditions.quote_anchor: We are truly envisioning this line holding the price down.

conditions.quote_anchor: all of the lines that we draw from higher time frames down to lower time frames have to connect. They're always going to connect to the previous point B.

conditions.quote_anchor: But this process gives us structure to how we draw our trend lines.

conditions.quote_anchor: when price finally does break, that gives us our indication to start taking action

conditions.quote_anchor: Top down analysis means that we are starting from the highest time frame and working our way down.

conditions.quote_anchor: the key point here is to make sure that price does not intersect

conditions.quote_anchor: we have to try to capture as many touch points as possible

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states the requirement to capture as many touch points as possible.

conditions.quote_anchor: An action line is the line that was broken. This triggers our decision to place a trade.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote defines the action line as the broken line and says it triggers the decision to place a trade.
